task: Improve Luna using reviewed real messages, compete against unchanged Jev1.13

fixed_parser.safe_veto: highest selected category > 1-unsafe; fail open on ties/late/errors

reviewed_real_data.source: Read-only production first-message screening snapshot; original verdicts withheld from two AI reviewers
reviewed_real_data.heldout_real: 113 benign, zero novel positive campaigns after campaign and previous-target exclusion; measures false positives only
reviewed_real_data.label_limit: AI consensus is provisional, not human moderator truth
reviewed_real_data.split_limit: Campaign groups disjoint; channels can overlap. No all-traffic or cross-channel accuracy claim.

development.selection: development: within each evaluation_group returned FP <= baseline, timely TP >= baseline, errors <= baseline; at least one strict overall TP/FP improvement; rank total returned FP ascending, timely TP descending, then variant order; baseline otherwise
development.fewshot_source: Development only; original prediction labels absent; examples in question instructions, never actual chat state

sealed_synthetic_challenge: New independently authored and blindly second-reviewed challenge, consented clear consensus only. Parent sees no case contents before selection freeze. Separate synthetic recall/generalization evidence, not real spam recall.

final_comparison_gate.real_false_positives: Luna must not have more returned or timely FP than Jev on the real benign heldout
final_comparison_gate.challenge: Luna must not have higher FP, fewer timely positive attempts/cases or more errors/late responses than Jev on sealed challenge
final_comparison_gate.strict_improvement: At least one FP/TP improvement required; ties retain incumbent Jev. A few-shot gain on training examples is not a win.
final_comparison_gate.limits: Cannot establish superior real-spam recall because real heldout has no unseen positive campaigns. Report limited recommendation, retain Jev unless convincing improvement without regressions.

cost.action: Notify when known cumulative benchmark spend exceeds1 USD and continue, as user instructed
cost.byok: Add upstream only when is_byok true; unknown cost remains unknown

scope: Offline benchmark only; no production prompt/model/config/deployment/database mutation.
